subcategory_text: Remediate AI vulnerabilities by patching model components, updating guardrails, retraining with hardened data, switching to safer prompts, or revoking/rolling back the affected model version.
implementation_examples: Patch guardrail rules to block the discovered jailbreak
Retrain on filtered or hardened data when poisoning is confirmed
Roll back to a known-good model version if a regression is detected
assessment_objectives: Determine whether AI vulnerabilities are addressed via patch, guardrail update, or rollback.
Determine whether remediation effectiveness is verified.
